# Qovira

> Qovira is a private, self-hostable personal assistant — reminders, notes, calendar, and quick answers, organized by AI that runs on a server you own and a model you choose.

Qovira keeps the personal core of your life — reminders, calendar, notes, tasks, and quick answers — as real, structured entries you talk to in plain language. Everything runs on a server you own and a model you choose; nothing phones home. It is open source and self-hosted, secure enough to put on the open internet, and yours alone.

This page is the placeholder for qovira.ai, published before the product ships. The product is open source and coming soon.

## Who it's for

People who want a capable personal assistant without handing their private life to a cloud service — anyone comfortable self-hosting (Linux/Docker) who wants reminders, notes, calendar, and quick answers organized by an AI they control.

## Privacy posture

- Private by architecture: Qovira runs on your own server, talking only to the model you choose.
- Nothing phones home: the self-hosted product never calls out on its own.
- Open source: auditable, and self-hostable for free.

## Links

- [GitHub](https://github.com/qovira/qovira): source code and self-host quickstart
